mediaPathMode.description: Relative paths start from the project file’s folder. Takes effect from the next save.

compressProjectFiles.description: Remove whitespace from the JSON to reduce file size, at the cost of readability.

concurrency.label: Concurrent transcription tasks
concurrency.description:
Lowering the limit does not affect running tasks.
Queued tasks start according to the new limit.
concurrency.invalid: The number of concurrent transcription tasks must be an integer from 1 to {{maximum}}.

referenceOverlap.label: Reference overlap threshold
referenceOverlap.description: Offer text from other transcriptions under “Replace with” and “Insert” when its time overlap with the target reaches this percentage of the shorter duration.
referenceOverlap.invalid: The overlap threshold must be an integer from 0 to 100.

followPlayback.label: Follow playback
followPlayback.description: Scroll the transcript to keep the playing text in view, the same way it follows the caret.

informationDisplay.label: Information display
informationDisplay.description: Choose where confidence, original text and time ranges appear.

hideTrivialInformation.label: Hide unremarkable probabilities
hideTrivialInformation.description: Leave probabilities out of tooltips for tokens at 100% confidence and 0% no-speech, and for no-speech gaps.

rewindStep.label: F7 rewind amount
rewindStep.description: How far F7 goes back on each press, without pausing or resuming playback.
rewindStep.invalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} milliseconds.

startRewind.label: Rewind when starting playback
startRewind.description: Each time playback starts, begin this far before the starting point. Set to 0 to turn it off.
startRewind.invalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} milliseconds.

volumeSliderMapping.description: Equal dB steps help distinguish quiet sounds, but the slider then no longer tracks perceived loudness.

volumeSliderMinDb.label: Minimum non-muted gain
volumeSliderMinDb.description: The gain at 1% slider position. 0% always mutes the audio.

wordSwitchPlayback.label: Playback after jumping to a word

rememberPlaybackPosition.label: Remember playback progress
rememberPlaybackPosition.description: Save each media file’s playback position in the project, and resume from it when you switch back.

pauseOnOutputDeviceChange.label: Pause when the audio output device changes
pauseOnOutputDeviceChange.description:
Pause playback when the system default audio output device changes or disconnects.
Playback will be paused regardless, if audio output device is taken by another device.

audioOffset.label: Audio synchronization offset
audioOffset.description: Negative values play audio earlier; positive values play it later.
audioOffset.instruction:
Press the button on the third beat.
Once calibrated, the moving line should cross the thick line exactly when you hear the third beat.
audioOffset.failed: Could not play the test audio. Check your audio output device and try again.

levelMeterReadout.label: Level meter source
levelMeterReadout.description: The clipping indicator also follows this point.

translucentSidebar.label: Translucent sidebar
translucentSidebar.description: Blend the sidebar with the colors of your desktop wallpaper.

sidebarTransparency.label: Transparency
sidebarTransparency.description: Higher values make the sidebar background more transparent.

maxGainDb.label: Maximum boost
maxGainDb.description: Limit how much quiet audio is amplified. Higher values may make background noise louder.

gainAttackMs.label: Gain reduction time
gainAttackMs.description: Smooth gain reduction when audio gets louder. Lower values reduce the gain faster.

gainReleaseMs.label: Gain recovery time
gainReleaseMs.description: Smooth gain increases when audio gets quieter. Higher values make the change more gradual.

gateThresholdDb.label: Quiet threshold
gateThresholdDb.description: Stop increasing gain below this level, then remove the boost if audio stays quiet.

targetLevelDb.label: Target level
targetLevelDb.description: The average level automatic gain aims for (subject to the maximum boost and peak limit).

models.title: Available models

details.whisperTiny: For whisper.cpp. Fast multilingual transcription with the lowest resource use, suited to modest hardware with limited accuracy. Runs on CPU; on GPU, weights take about 0.07 GiB of memory.
details.whisperBase: For whisper.cpp. Lightweight multilingual transcription, more accurate than Tiny and suited to clear speech. Runs on CPU; on GPU, weights take about 0.14 GiB of memory.
details.whisperSmall: For whisper.cpp. Multilingual transcription balancing accuracy and speed with moderate resource use. Runs on CPU; on GPU, weights take about 0.45 GiB of memory.
details.whisperLargeV3: For whisper.cpp. Multilingual transcription focused on accuracy, with slower processing and high resource use. Runs on CPU; on GPU, weights take about 2.88 GiB of memory.
details.whisperLargeV3Turbo: For whisper.cpp. Faster than Large v3 with a small accuracy tradeoff; repetition and hallucinations remain possible. Runs on CPU; on GPU, weights take about 1.51 GiB of memory.
details.paraformerZh: For sherpa-onnx. Fast, non-autoregressive recognition focused on Chinese, including mixed Chinese and English speech. Moderate resource use; runs on CPU; on GPU, weights take about 0.77 GiB of memory.
details.senseVoiceSmall: For sherpa-onnx. Fast recognition of Mandarin, Cantonese, English, Japanese and Korean, with text timestamps. Low resource use with INT8; CPU recommended; on GPU, weights take about 0.22 GiB of memory.
details.fireRedAsr2Ctc: For sherpa-onnx. CTC recognition for Chinese, English, mixed speech and Chinese dialects, with text timestamps. Moderate resource use with INT8; CPU recommended; on GPU, weights take about 0.72 GiB of memory.
details.qwen3Asr06b: For sherpa-onnx. Supports 30 languages and Chinese dialects, including singing and songs with accompaniment. Focuses on efficiency, with moderate INT8 memory use and CPU support; on GPU, weights take about 0.92 GiB of memory; text timestamps are currently unavailable.
details.qwen3Asr17b: For sherpa-onnx. Supports 30 languages and Chinese dialects, including singing and songs with accompaniment. Focuses on accuracy, with higher INT8 memory use, slower processing and CPU support; on GPU, weights take about 2.23 GiB of memory; text timestamps are currently unavailable.

about.name: Vestige (理学)
about.description:
A workspace for editing and proofreading transcripts, and exploring the archaeology of your own life.
We preserve memories to keep a doorway to another possibility, at least in our hearts.
With them, we can live our lives over, thousands upon thousands of times.
about.quote:
I have made many choices. Some quietly, without noticing; others after careful thought. In happiness and in sorrow. Some of my own accord, others under pressure. Some fell naturally into place; others came about by chance.
I know that, long from now, somewhere, one night, I will remember the roads to the rose garden that I never took.
I chose one road, and that has made all the difference.
